evidence.title: Claude Design by Dapta - Open Registration · Luma

name: Claude Design by Dapta
summary: Sold-out San Francisco workshop on building a Claude Design landing page and wiring a voice AI agent to call leads.
description: Luma event page for a Dapta workshop at Frontier Tower SF: participants generate a branded landing page with Claude Design from prompts, build a no-code voice AI agent that calls a lead the second a form submits, and wire the full funnel (landing page, intake form, webhook, voice call) live on stage. Lists who it is for, what to bring (a laptop and a Claude Pro/Max account), the agenda and the venue.
contains: live build: landing page, intake form, webhook, voice AI call
what to bring: laptop and a Claude Pro/Max account
hosted at Frontier Tower SF; 244 went; registration sold out
agenda: arrivals 5:00 PM, workshop 5:30-7:00 PM, pizza and networking 7:00-8:00 PM
hosted by Frontier Tower and Dapta AI
